name: Webwood Spider Silk
summary: Webwood Spider Silk is gathered from Webwood Lurkers in the woods of Teldrassil. Crafters use spider silk in many ways, but these swatches draw the interest of suspicious figures among the World Tree’s boughs.

sections.title: A Dubious Reagent
sections.body: Webwood Lurkers around Dolanaar spin a fine, strong thread that is dangerous to gather. Zenn Foulhoof, a satyr along the forest road, asks young adventurers to collect the silk with nightsaber fangs and strigid owl feathers. He says these rare reagents are needed for his forest business, and newcomers gather them without asking about his corrupt nature or true motives.

faq.q: Where can Webwood Spider Silk be found?
aliases: where to get webwood spider silk
faq.answer: Webwood Spider Silk comes from Webwood Lurkers and related spiders in Teldrassil’s wilds, especially around Dolanaar.
Zenn Foulhoof wants the silk. The satyr conceals his dealings just north of the path between Shadowglen and Dolanaar, and asks for it alongside owl feathers and predator fangs.

faq.q: Why does Zenn Foulhoof want Webwood Spider Silk?
faq.answer: Zenn says he needs the silk as a reagent for his forest business, but keeps its details to himself.

faq.q: Can players use Webwood Spider Silk for tailoring?
faq.answer: No. Though it is genuine spider silk, this harvested thread is a reagent for a task, not ordinary tailoring cloth.

angles.text: As a young night elf leaving Shadowglen, take care with the creatures you hunt, especially when a solitary satyr near your heartland presses you to gather them.
As a tailor, you may seek arachnid thread, but these swatches are bound up in dark bargains with a satyr rather than ordinary loom work.
